title: Validate a webhook event against a clock
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Own-key presence, Number.isInteger and an array-aware object test implement every field rule, the inclusive 300 second window and the event_type short circuit.
It never reports created_future, so an otherwise valid event created 301 seconds after now returns [] instead of ["created_future"], and it tells the grader to disregard that rule of the brief.
Explicit type and floor checks, a hex character scan for the id and a signed age against now produce exactly the codes the brief defines.
Its data test does not exclude arrays, so data: [] returns ["amount_invalid", "currency_invalid"] instead of ["data_type"], as the brief's own example requires.
